svg.aria-label: index.html: Markup + the module script that wires everything up. data/articles.json: The articles: id, headline, text (HTML). js/articles/: Fetch, button factory, button event listeners. js/aria/: ARIA attributes for the overlay and its buttons. js/utility/: Overlay state, side menu, debouncer, Escape key. css/: Variables, layout, components, utilities. fonts/: Roboto Regular + Bold. Dockerfile: nginx:alpine image that serves the folder. docker-compose.yml: Port 8080 -> 80, mounts the folder into nginx
